goal: Stage 5 part 5: tail, built in parallel with the hind paw fix on the hind-leg pass 1 file, delivered as a region delta; Codex

method: Read the approved base and copied all supplied references to named input files.
Measured clay side thickness normal to the tail curve at root, one third, two thirds, and 95 percent; normalized by rump height.
Built a smooth Hermite centerline through unchanged tail joints and selected only the tail plus the declared root band.
Edited existing vertices in place into a steady radial taper. Preserved all body vertex indices, edges, faces, armature weights, and joints.
Replaced the hard radial boundary with smooth falloff, then softened root channels with 24 weighted Laplacian steps confined to that region.
Turned the last curve tangent upright at the fixed tip position; changed length by less than one percent.
Rendered each iteration with Cycles on CPU using shared look-dev lights, ground, clay, and orthographic tail cameras. Rendered all five full-body cameras and the 192 px sprite.

Exported a coordinate delta and an extracted tail GLB, applied the delta to the untouched base, and checked exact equality plus non-tail invariants. Tested refusal on a deliberately missing coordinate.
Compared final renders with normalized clay crops, reviewed all full-body views, and obtained an independent read-only visual review.
remains: Faint shallow root-flank channels remain visible in the top view. They are softened and do not create an abrupt step or constriction.
The root fraction is approximately 9 percent above the manual clay estimate at the joint plane, preserving a smooth attachment. The other three thickness stations closely match the measurements.
Fine tip contrast is weak in the rear three-quarter lighting. The hook is clear in side silhouette and survives at 192 pixels.
The supplied three-quarter clay image is a front three-quarter view. The required rear camera is not an angle-matched comparison. No clay top view was supplied.

holds.hold: Tail joints and plume socket unchanged
holds.evidence: delta_proof.json: no armature or object transform differences.

holds.hold: Centerline length within 5 percent of base
holds.evidence: Nominal 0.52639 to 0.52840 m, +0.38 percent; surface cross-check +0.20 percent.

holds.hold: Every vertex outside tail and declared root band unmoved
holds.evidence: Maximum 0 m and mean 0 m outside region. Other mesh coordinates unchanged.
Topology unchanged everywhere, including tail. All vertex groups and weights unchanged.

checks.title: Tail, Codex pass 1
checks.question: Does the tail read as the clay?
checks.recommended: Critic read: pass. Root, taper (thickness fractions within 1 percent of the clay at three of four stations, root 9 percent thicker for a smooth attachment), low curve and upward hook match the clay side; 1.04 times body length.
